english.note: This is the all-purpose term for a professional barber, especially in neutral or careful speech.

exampleSentences.english: I booked a barber to trim my beard.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我約咗理髮師幫我修剪鬍鬚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 joek3 zo2 lei5 faat3 si1 bong1 ngo5 sau1 zin2 wu4 sou1

english.note: Use this more formal term when emphasizing someone whose occupation is cutting hair, especially in a barbering context.

exampleSentences.english: This hairdresser specializes in shaving customers’ beards.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢位理髮師專門替客人剃鬚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wai2 lei5 faat3 si1 zyun1 mun4 tai3 haak3 jan4 tai3 sou1
